about: The two calls about stagenet's genesis block that startup makes (its hash, chain_getBlockHash [0], and its header), copied verbatim from records 2 and 19 of the tape stagenet-0-10000 (test/tape/real/manifest.json, SHA-256 a21d1ca8e0665c53e1545c3ce3683ea471cbdfb81f75821e66df6ff5a24d80ee). The tapes stagenet-714485-715183 and stagenet-715402-715433 start mid-chain and do not hold them; stagenet.test.ts puts them before those tapes' records.
